journey.title: Prove a device can run a flow, then run it
journey.purpose: The core operator loop: confirm what a device can actually do, check a flow against it before spending device time, run it under an explicit lease, and review the evidence.

steps.intent: Find the target device and see its probed capability tier.
Confirm which strategy would be selected and which capabilities are proven.
Check the flow against this device and confirm there is no capability gap.
Acquire the lease and execute, with holder, expiry and kill visible throughout.
Review the chapter timeline, the rung used per step, and the redacted evidence references.
